name: Talkiatry
short_description: Nation's largest full-stack telepsychiatry provider with 800+ employed psychiatrists, proprietary AI-powered platform, and measurement-based care showing 87% anxiety improvement rates.
long_description: Talkiatry is the nation's largest full-stack telepsychiatry provider, directly employing over 800 board-certified psychiatrists as W-2 employees. Founded in 2019, the company operates on a proprietary AI-powered technology platform that includes a bespoke psychiatry EHR, intelligent patient-provider matching, and automated operational workflows. Talkiatry practices measurement-based care using standardized assessments including PHQ-9 and GAD-7, reporting strong clinical outcomes: 87% of anxiety patients and 86% of depression patients report symptom improvement after just two visits, with 67% and 62% respectively reporting no longer having clinically significant symptoms. The company is in-network with over 100 insurers covering 170+ million lives and has partnered with more than one-third of the nation's top 20 health systems through its Mindshare Partner Program. In February 2026, Talkiatry raised $210M in Series D funding to continue expansion.

seo.title: Talkiatry for Psychiatrists: Employment Review & Compensation | HeyPsych
seo.meta_description: Talkiatry employs 800+ psychiatrists as W2 with 90% retention. Clinician co-founded. $324k average comp (3.7/5 rating). Honest review for psychiatrists considering Talkiatry.

faqs.q: How much do Talkiatry psychiatrists make?
faqs.a: Talkiatry psychiatrists average $324k/year total compensation (Indeed, 17% above national average). Glassdoor reports $272k-$467k range based on 51 salaries. However, base salary is reportedly $120-150k with productivity-based incentives making up the rest. The 3.7/5 compensation rating is above company average.

Yes, Talkiatry was co-founded by Dr. Georgia Gaveras (board-certified psychiatrist) and Robert Krayn (tech/business). As Dr. Gaveras says, 'He's the money, I'm the medicine.' She was named to Modern Healthcare's 50 Most Influential Clinical Executives 2025.

Talkiatry uses base salary plus productivity-based incentives (RVU-based). Base salary is reportedly $120-150k, with incentive pay based on patient volume. Reviews note the base is low but total comp can be competitive with high productivity. Taking time off reduces incentive pay.

faqs.q: What is Talkiatry's psychiatrist retention rate?
faqs.a: Talkiatry reports 90%+ provider retention rate, compared to 30-40% industry average. This suggests above-average clinician satisfaction despite compensation concerns in some reviews.

Talkiatry reports 87% of anxiety patients and 86% of depression patients show improvement after just 2 visits. Mean PHQ-9 reduction is 4.8 points at 12 weeks for moderate-to-severe depression. They use standardized PHQ-9 and GAD-7 assessments.

faqs.q: Does Talkiatry provide AI tools for documentation?
faqs.a: Yes, Talkiatry provides an AI scribe for documentation. They have a proprietary psychiatry-specific EHR with AI-powered patient matching and automated workflows. This reduces administrative burden compared to traditional practices.
